name: Repo-Readme-Creator
description: Repository readme generator is a tool that allows you to create simple and beautiful readme for your repository that you can copy/paste/download.

paragraphs: Craft beautiful, professional READMEs with live preview and powerful features.

Repo README Creator is a standalone, browser-based tool that provides a modern, efficient, and enjoyable experience for creating professional README files. It's a complete overhaul of the original concept, rebuilt from the ground up with a modern tech stack and a focus on an excellent user experience.
With a real-time preview, section templates, and automatic saving, you can craft the perfect README for your project in a fraction of the time.
features: Modern Tech Stack: Built with Vue 3 (Composition API) for a reactive and performant experience.
🎨 Refreshed UI/UX: A clean, responsive design styled with Tailwind CSS, including a beautiful dark mode.
💾 State Persistence: Your work is automatically saved to your browser's local storage. Never lose your progress on a refresh!
🚀 Section Templates: Quickly add common sections like "Features," "API Reference," or "License" from a pre-filled list.
🔒 Secure Live Preview: See your rendered Markdown in real-time. The preview is sanitized with DOMPurify for enhanced security.

whatItDoes.text: Craft beautiful, professional READMEs with live preview and powerful features.
